title: Crystal bottle in the wax cascade

tokens.v: Set it where the raking key passes clean through the cut facets, throwing a fan of hard-edged burgundy caustics across the matte set wax beside it while the gold dome takes one hot specular. Catch a single drip at the leading edge necking under its own weight, the strand drawn to a thread and about to part. 100mm macro at f/4, camera level with the shoulder. Acid-etched VERLAINE, small on one shoulder facet, shows as matte frost only where the key rakes it. A cooling ribbon blurs across the top-right, cut by the top edge. The mark named above is deliberate art direction: disregard the later Avoid clause forbidding text, labels, stickers or engraving on this product.
